# migrations

Migrations move a running instance to a different compute node.

## POST /v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/projects/{project_id}/instances/{instance_id}/migrate

Operation `project_instance_migrate`.

Start a live migration of a running instance (LM-5). The body's `action` dispatches between begin / estimate / pause / switch / abort / rollback / finalize / sync.
